lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with 3-5 primary nodes per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running parallel to the longitudinal axis, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: High density of smaller, lower-intensity white pixel clusters located on the leading edge and distal surface of the pectoral fin.
